opportunities.title: Small grants

amount.raw: Awards vary according to project but will only exceptionally exceed £6,000 and will generally fall in a range of £1,500-£5,000. Travel and subsistence up to £2,000 per person for trips up to 13 days, up to £2,500 for 14 days or more; up to £5,000 for PhD fieldwork visits of six months or more.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must belong to, or provide evidence of support from, an organisation or institution willing to receive grant funds. Applications not accepted from individuals seeking support for personal projects. UK projects submitted to UK office, Japan projects to Japan office.
opportunities.summary: Seed funding to enable UK-Japan projects that bring people in the UK and Japan together to deepen mutual understanding, exchange ideas or expertise, or develop lasting collaboration. Supports festivals, workshops, performances, exchanges, collaborative projects, Japanese language teaching, and academic research/visits.

opportunities.title: Butterfield Awards in Medicine and Health

amount.raw: Butterfield Awards of up to £10,000; continuing projects lasting up to three years to a maximum of £10,000 per year, to a total limit of £30,000.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to health and medical professionals, researchers, practitioners, policy makers, managers and voluntary sector workers in the UK and Japan. Applicants should normally show an existing research record. Preference given to those not previously involved in UK-Japan collaboration and early-career applicants.
opportunities.summary: Supports exchanges and collaborations between health and medical professionals in Japan and the UK, including study of scientific, clinical, social and economic issues in healthcare. Grants may be used for travel expenses or to contribute to other costs including conference and publication costs.
